content.title: Review idea: E2E cleanupE2ESeeds parallel-DELETE race leaves stragglers
content.description: Idea mqh5aew5am needs your decision. Found during validation of mqh3syrrnb (E2E isolation hardening). DEFECT (low-medium severity, no real-data leak): cleanupE2ESeeds() in packages/webapp/e2e/setup.ts issues parallel DELETEs via Promise.all against the agentrack backend; the backend's file store performs unlocked read-modify-write cycles on index.json/issue files, so concurrent DELETEs race and some are silently dropped. Validated repro: seeded 3 tagged issues, ran cleanup once (parallel) -> 2 of 3 remained; second pass cleared the rest. Impact: the README claim about no stale seeds left behind is weaker than reality; stragglers only accumulate inside validation/.e2edata/ until the next global-setup reset, so no real-data leak. Adjacent minor cosmetic bug (same area, packages/webapp/e2e/global-setup.ts): Layer A guard error message has a literal '${BACKEND_PORT}' because a double-quoted string is used instead of a backtick template literal. Suggested fix (serialize DELETEs in a for...of await, or loop list-then-delete-until-empty, or retry per delete). As the webapp team's tech lead, decide: (1) accept (plan a fix to webapp-developer); (2) refine; or (3) discard (e.g. if global-setup reset makes it moot). Add your decision as a comment, then mark this task done.

content.content:
## Decision: ACCEPT (with severity refinements)

I verified the claim against the actual code. The **core finding is technically correct and worth fixing**; two of the supporting framings are not.

### Verified facts
1. **Parallel DELETEs confirmed.** `packages/webapp/e2e/setup.ts` lines 152-163 issue all deletes via `Promise.all(seeds.map(...))` — concurrent fetches, no serialization.
2. **Unlocked store confirmed.** `playwright.config.ts` (lines 21-30) and `e2e/README.md` (lines 82-84) both document that the backend performs *unlocked read-modify-write* on `index.json`/issue files. `workers: 1` only serializes *specs*, not concurrent in-process requests — so the race surface the idea describes is real.
3. **`cleanupE2ESeeds` swallows errors silently** (lines 158-161), so a dropped delete leaves no trace.

So yes: under contention, parallel DELETEs against the file store can race and silently drop some deletes. The repro in the idea (2 of 3 surviving the first pass) is plausible.

### Where I would refine the idea's framing
- **"README claim weaker than reality" — not quite.** The README is accurately hedged: it explicitly calls Layer B *"defense-in-depth"*, says it *"tolerates already-deleted ids"*, and names the global-setup reset as the *"authoritative wipe"*. It does **not** promise zero stragglers. So the docs are honest; the bug is in the implementation, not the docs.
- **"No real-data leak" — agreed.** Layer A (`resetWorktreeData()` in `global-setup.ts`) wipes the whole `validation/.e2edata/` directory at the start of every run (README section 5), so any stragglers survive only until the next run begins. Severity is correctly **low-medium**, not a leak.
- **Adjacent cosmetic bug — does NOT exist in current code.** I grepped every occurrence of `${BACKEND_PORT}` in `e2e/global-setup.ts`; all of them (lines 21, 32, 47, 65, 74) live inside backtick template literals and interpolate correctly. No double-quoted literal is present. This sub-claim is stale and should be dropped.

### Fix recommendation
Trivial and low-risk: serialize the deletes in `cleanupE2ESeeds` — replace the `Promise.all(seeds.map(...))` with a `for...of await` loop. This keeps the helper's role (best-effort Layer B) intact while removing the only concurrency the single-worker serialization cannot protect against. No backend changes needed.

### Action
Accepting. Creating a child implementation task for the fix (serialize DELETEs in `cleanupE2ESeeds`). Marking this review done so gate tracker `mqiaxjq61m` can proceed.
Created implementation task mqib7bbznm (assigned to project-manager for triage/runner pickup) to serialize the deletes in cleanupE2ESeeds. This review is complete.

Status loop audit: the reviewer's comment explicitly states the decision (ACCEPT, serialize the DELETEs in cleanupE2ESeeds) and 'This review is complete.' The blockage on gate tracker mqiaxjq61m already auto-resolved. Marking this review done on the reviewer's behalf — it was a missed status flip, not incomplete work. Gate mqiaxjq61m is now ready for the work loop to wake the PM to read the decision and act.
